values.note: Open all year except mid-September to mid-October, when the Carolina Classic Fair uses the grounds. In winter and cold weather, water may be off while facilities are winterized.

season.source: https://wsfairgrounds.com/campground/ ('The RV Campground is available for use throughout the year with the exception of mid-September through mid-October due to the annual Carolina Classic Fair'; '*During winter and cold weather months, water may not be available due to the winterization of facilities.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Spaces are first come, first served, but must be paid in full in advance through the Fairgrounds' online portal (Eventeny); no cash on site. Reservations cannot be cancelled within 3 days of arrival. After 21 consecutive nights, guests must leave for at least a week. Must be 21+ to book. Rally groups and special events (e.g. the November dog show) book separately.

booking.source: https://wsfairgrounds.com/campground/ ('Camping spaces are available on a first come, first served basis. The nightly rate is $35. Full payment is required prior to occupying any site. No cash payments are accepted onsite; all reservation payments must be made through our portal.'; 'The maximum stay is 21 consecutive days'; 'BOOK YOUR GENERAL RESERVATION NOW!' -> Eventeny) + https://www.eventeny.com/events/wsfairgroundscamping-30164/ ('Winston-Salem Fairgrounds Camping', May 1, 2026 - Jul 1, 2027), read 2026-10-22

fees.source: https://wsfairgrounds.com/campground/ ('The nightly rate is $35.'; page © 2026), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Winston-Salem (Fairgrounds) RV campground at 569 Fairgrounds Blvd, entered at Gate 7; the gate and bathhouse open with a code sent on booking. Not a long-term stay facility. --Claude
